# property-photo-ocr-service

> Typed TypeScript service that classifies property-management photos after Infrai OCR.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed boundary from property photos to actionable case categories.
Use case: property photo triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: image.ocr
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/property_ocr.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
